Features.Description: Owners can enable Shift Shortage Alerts in Settings for each store, choose a shortage limit, and add up to ten recipient emails. Only owners and password-unlocked developers can change this setup.
Features.Title: Owner-controlled shift shortage emails

Features.Description: When an entered drop is short by more than the chosen limit, a detailed email and PDF show the shortage prominently in red. Waiting drops are checked after their report arrives. Delivery retries in the background, with status available in the alert settings.
Features.Title: Detailed reports and background delivery
